scenes.line1: Who gets access to your data?
scenes.say: Ever wonder who can see your data, and how you can share it securely in the cloud?

scenes.label: Access
scenes.sub: Granular control uses roles and permissions.
scenes.say: Cloud warehouses use roles and permissions to give fine-grained access. You decide who can read, write, or manage each resource.

scenes.title: Granting Table Access
scenes.say: For example, in Snowflake, you grant select access on the sales table to the analyst role. Only users with that role can query sales.
Data sharing means you can share datasets across accounts or organizations without copying data. In BigQuery, you use IAM roles to control access by project.

scenes.question: What's the best practice for access?
scenes.say: Interview trap: Don’t just give everyone full access. Always use least-privilege roles and permissions to keep data safe.
